jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact.
